'''Meedis Minor''' was an astronomical object<ref name="Author's Cut">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-12-tales-of-the-new-republic|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 12: Tales of the New Republic}}</ref> located in the [[Meedis Minor system/Legends|Meedis Minor system]], a part of the [[Tandon sector/Legends|Tandon sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> At one point, a pair of dour [[Gender/Legends|ladies]] were traveling aboard the [[Passenger liner/Legends|starliner]] ''[[Pendrake's Horizons]]'' that was captured by [[Thalassian slavers/Legends|Thalassian slavers]] off [[Phibia]]<ref name="Author's Cut" /> in the [[Haserian sector/Legends|Haserian sector]].<ref name="EAOC Phibia">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Phibia system/Legends|Phibia system]]</ref> The ladies from Meedis Minor were eventually rescued by the [[Corellian Security Force]] agent [[Bey]].<ref name="Author's Cut" />

==Behind the scenes==
Meedis Minor was originally meant to be mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]; however, the section that would have mentioned the celestial body was cut before the book's release. The section was itself a revised version<ref name="Author's Cut" /> of a cut segment originally written by Fry for inclusion in [[Star Wars Insider 91|''Star Wars Insider'' 91]]<ref name="Author's Cut 8">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 8: Tales of the Clone Wars}}</ref> in [[November]] [[2006]].<ref name="Insider date">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20061114.html|text=Inside ''Star Wars Insider'' #91}}</ref>

The information regarding Meedis Minor was later released in [[2014]] as part of [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut]], a series of articles published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]] by Fry and<ref name="Author's Cut" /> [[Del Rey]] editor<ref name="Celestials">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-the-celestials|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut &mdash; The Celestials|int=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut}}</ref> [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] containing various cut content from ''The Essential Guide to Warfare''.<ref name="Author's Cut" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Meedis Minor [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Meedis Minor itself, in grid square Q-13.<ref name="TEA" />
